newsitem.title: THAILAND: Thai stocks end up on late bargain hunting.
newsitem.headline: Thai stocks end up on late bargain hunting.

text.p: Late bargain hunting pushed Thai stocks up slightly on Friday at the close after bargain-hunters bought selected bank, property and energy issues late, brokers said.
The SET index rose 2.19 points to 912.52 on thin 2.1 billion baht turnover. The SET-50 index gained 0.29 point to 68.92.
"Local investors entered the market and bought cheap but large capitalised stocks less than one minute before the market closed," said a broker at a foreign brokerage.

The entertainment and recreation sector gained most today, rising 1.02 percent. The banking sector rose 0.64 percent while the property sector advanced 0.29 percent and the energy sector gained 0.53 percent.
Large capitalised Finance One topped the active list, falling one baht to 58. Bangkok Bank rose two to 194 and Juldis Develop slipped 2.50 to 24.
